story.title: 'Symbol of Atmanirbhar Bharat': PM Modi highlights INS Mahendragiri in Mann Ki Baat
story.summary: PM Narendra Modi hailed INS Mahendragiri as a symbol of 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' in Mann Ki Baat, saying the warship was designed and built in India with over 75% indigenous content. He also highlighted recent DRDO missile tests and India's growing defence capabilities.
